ticket.title: Bulk action to mark selected invoices as paid
ticket.description: Accountants currently mark invoices as paid one by one after each bank import, which is slow. Add a bulk action in the invoice list: select several invoices with checkboxes, then use a Mark as paid button that appears once at least one is selected, with a confirmation dialog showing how many invoices will change, paid date defaulting to today, and already paid invoices skipped.

feature.userNeed: Accountants need to mark many invoices as paid at once after each bank import, because marking them one by one takes a long time.
feature.proposedBehavior: In the invoice list, show a checkbox for each invoice so several can be selected. When at least one invoice is selected, show a button called Mark as paid. Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog that shows how many invoices will be changed. The paid date is set to today by default. Invoices that are already paid are skipped and not changed.
acceptanceCriteria: The invoice list shows a checkbox for each invoice.
The Mark as paid button appears when at least one invoice is selected and is hidden when none are selected.
Clicking Mark as paid opens a confirmation dialog that shows the number of invoices that will be changed.
The paid date defaults to today's date.
Invoices that are already paid are not changed when the action is confirmed.

missingInformation.question: Is the title correct, or should it name the invoice list or the bank import more specifically?
Is the user need correct as stated, or should another role besides accountants be included?
Should the paid date be editable in the confirmation dialog, or is today's date fixed?
Should the bulk action also be available outside the invoice list, for example after a bank import?

ticket.title: Add dark mode toggle in user menu that persists after login
ticket.description: Add a dark mode switch in the user menu so users can turn dark mode on and off. The app should remember the choice the next time the user logs in. The speaker says many users work late in the evening and the white screen is hard on the eyes.

feature.userNeed: A lot of users work late in the evening and the white screen is hard on the eyes.
feature.proposedBehavior: Add a switch in the user menu to turn dark mode on and off, and have the app remember the user's choice the next time they log in.
acceptanceCriteria: A dark mode switch is available in the user menu.
Turning the switch on changes the app to dark mode.
Turning the switch off returns the app to the default light mode.
After the user logs in again, the app uses the dark mode setting the user last chose.
